notes.content:
[previewyoutube=0V4L6TAY6fo;full][/previewyoutube]
1. New Event: When the Wind Gusts
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073129/831871fa5ba33640c806e2fc23dab4ddafa02d12.png
1) Event Period: 9/23 After maintenance – 10/9 1:59 P.M. (UTC-7);
2) Event Details: During the event, the event page would update event missions every day at 2:00 P.M. (UTC- 7). Complete them to obtain event items. Collect the required number to claim generous rewards including event-limited emotes, Event Illustration, Sage's Bags, and more on the "Lantern's Wish" event page.

*More details can be found on the event page.
*Excluding matches against AI. Unfulfilled daily missions will not be retained.
*The event illustration may appear in the Illustration Shop roster after the event period.

2. Limited-Time Summon Update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073129/5fac01e26b9ff4130373f781e70540220c063654.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073129/fed0a88184a3499b0a586521d458b34a33027462.png
1) Summon: Sakura Bloom Limited-Time Rate Up
9/23 After maintenance – 10/1 1:59 P.M. (UTC-7), Yui Yagi & Yuan Xiao rate up.
10/1 2:00 P.M. – 10/9 1:59 P.M. (UTC-7), Kaavi & Fu Ji rate up.

2) Summon: Bamboo Lush Limited-Time Rate Up
9/23 After maintenance – 10/1 1:59 P.M. (UTC-7), Yuan Feng & Ling rate up.
10/1 2:00 P.M. – 10/9 1:59 P.M. (UTC-7), Wanjirou & Ryan rate up.

3) Rerun Special Effects and Decorations:
[Tile Back - Seal Magic], [Tablecloth - Imprisoned Sword], [Riichi Music - The Ultimate Battle], and [Portrait Frame - Woof].

*The special effects and decorations will be UNAVAILABLE to obtain after 10/9 at 1:59 P.M. (UTC-7).
*You can check the rate of characters and decorations in the corresponding Summon - Details.

3. New Outfits, Outfit of Your Choice, and Return of Favorite Outfits
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073129/6648793bec7e71f440b9d15829c74d2b8c558d3a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073129/027532e9e38574039aee45a7489510eedd08fac8.png
1) Available Period: 9/23 After maintenance – 10/9 1:59 P.M. (UTC-7).
2) Limited-Time New Outfits in Outfit Shop:
[Shape of a Fading Echo - Yui Yagi (Animated)], [Shape of a Fading Echo - Yuan Xiao (Animated)], [Shape of a Fading Echo - Yuan Feng], and [Shape of a Fading Echo - Ling].

3) Limited-Time Outfit of Your Choice in Outfit Shop:
You can purchase any single outfit of your choice during the event (one-time purchase only). The [Outfit of Your Choice] can be chosen from all the outfits of regular characters (excludes collab outfits and does not contain special bonus decorations).

4) Limited-Time Return of Favorite Outfits in Outfit Shop:
[Daybreak in G Major - Kaavi (Animated)], [Spring Song - Ichihime], [Beachside Vacation - Fu Ji (Animated)], and [Beachside Vacation - Wanjirou].

*You need to have the character to equip their outfit(s).
*You can check currently owned outfits in Item - Outfit.
*The animation effect of the Animated Outfits can be turned on/off in Dorm, the animation effect is not supported in some interfaces.
*You can go to Dorm - Character - View and click the character's avatar to change the outfit.

4. Added the "Team" season type to Mahjong Soul Tournament Management Center
1) Added the "Team" season type. You can view or change the current season type on the Season Information page.
2) Added Team Management feature. After enabling the Team mode, you can create multiple teams and assign members on the Team Management page. Once teams are set up, team names will be displayed in matches and in spectating.
3) Added Seasonal Team Rankings. It is based on the combined total score of all members on the team. Tournament admins can also modify team scores on the Player Statistics page.

*Team mode results are only supported for matches played after maintenance.
*For details, please refer to the Tournament Management Center web page.

5. Others
Optimized the behavior for returning to the previous page after viewing logs in some interfaces.

5. New & Rerun Outfits
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073129/169da9ccd3919206fd573b97e6eac9eb7bebcce6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073129/ea87c42c696438f8f5e69bc01423271eaf0d521d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073129/84be55f69a07f12765b045c0e670e058fd86942e.png
1) Available Period: 8/19 After maintenance – 9/9 1:59 P.M. (UTC-7);
2) Limited-Time New Outfits in Outfit Shop:
[Tangled Vow - Li Yang (Animated)], [Summer Night Breeze - Qing Luan (Animated)], [Summer Night Breeze - Momo Hina (Animated)], [Summer Night Breeze - Nanaha Onodera], and [Summer Night Breeze - Kutsuji (Animated)].
3) Limited-Time Rerun Outfits in Outfit Shop:
[Playful Summertime - Yuzu (Animated)], [Playful Summertime - Chihori Terasaki (Animated)], [Playful Summertime - Miki Nikaidou], and [Playful Summertime - Ling].

*The animation effect of the Animated Outfits can be turned on/off in Dorm; the animation effect is not supported in some interfaces.
*You can go to Dorm - Character - View and click the character's avatar to change the outfit.

6. "MAKA" Now Includes 3-Player Match Analysis 
After this update, "MAKA" can support the analysis of all historical 3-player Ranked matches (East/South), as well as Friendly/Tournament Matches that use the same rules as Ranked matches.

*Please refer to the in-game performance for details.

7. New Voice Lines
All characters (including collab characters) now have five new voice lines: [Match Start], [Match End - 1st Place (win by Ron)], [Match End - 1st Place (win by high points)], [SP - Entering Friends Room], and [SP - Ready in Friends Room].
These voice lines will play in the corresponding scenes once the bond level and trigger conditions are met.

*Please refer to the in-game performance for details.

8. New Achievement Rewards
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073129/278ab671a0db4005f0ba7f250abe7545b5623db7.png
After this update, some achievements will be added with new decorations and music:
Achieving the [Bonded with Ichihime] achievement will unlock the [Lobby Music – Mayo Yakisoba].
Achieving the [In Honor of Logging in for 30 Consecutive Days] achievement will unlock the [Riichi Music – Chord of the Future].
Achieving the [Four Symbols - Jade Trial] achievement will unlock the [Tablecloth - The Verdant Ascent].
Achieving the [Three Enclosures - Jade Trial] achievement will unlock the [Tablecloth - The Vermilion Gale].
Achieving the [Four Symbols - Skilled] achievement will unlock the [Tablecloth - The Gilded Roar].
Achieving the [Three Enclosures - Skilled] achievement will unlock the [Tablecloth - The Obsidian Shell].
Achieving the [Four Symbols - No.1 Ⅱ] achievement will unlock the [Tile Back - Guardian of the South].
Achieving the [Three Enclosures - No.1 Ⅱ] achievement will unlock the [Tile Back - Guardian of the West].
Achieving the [Restriction of Power Ⅲ] achievement will unlock the [Tile Back - Guardian of the North].
Achieving the [Blessings Come] achievement will unlock the [Tile Back - Guardian of the East].

*Rewards for completed achievements can be claimed directly on the Achievement page.
*Please refer to the in-game Achievement page for details.

9. New Illustration and Story
Yui Yagi's story has been added to Dorm, check the character in Dorm and click View - Story to see the contents and get rewards. You can unlock Story by leveling up Bond.
Unlock the endings to collect rewards including the Character's Illustration, Summon Scroll, and Sunshine Lucky Bag.

10. Others
1) Added "View Log" button. After the match, you can click this button at the top right to directly access this match's log.
2) Optimized the display of the review interface in the character story.

notes.content:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073129/34d9ad4dfb5168a3a60bb06ed0a1149af63e374c.png
1) Event Period: 4/22 After maintenance - 5/13 1:59 P.M. (UTC-7)
2) Event Details: Ichihime's training journey is full of surprises. Join her in aiming for the highest score! Help Ichihime enhance her Attributes to compete against other competitors and reach the top in the competition. During the event, complete missions to earn Boost Cans to help Ichihime with her training. Meet certain requirements to claim generous rewards, including the Limited Collab Background, Limited Collab Illustration, Summon Scrolls, and Sage's Bag in the [Rewards] on the event page! When a certain time arrives, you can also watch the event story in the [Story].
Special Rules: During the event, you can experience the brand-new high-risk, high-reward game mode "Riichi Siege" via the event page, where you will be randomly matched for the game. 
Additionally, the Friendly Match mode with the same rules will be temporarily available during the event period. Advanced settings will not be supported and Missions cannot be completed in this mode.

*Limited Collab Background and Limited Collab Illustration can only be obtained in this event.
*Ranked Matches and Event Matches will count towards completing daily event missions, while Friendly Matches will not. More details can be found on the event page.

4. 6th Anniversary Special Bonus: First Purchase RESET
To celebrate the 6th Anniversary of Mahjong Soul EN, the First Purchase Bonus of all tiers of the Jade purchase will get reset (Fortune Charm not included).

*The First Purchase Bonus will not be retained for tiers that have not been purchased before, which means the First Purchase Bonus will not be triggered twice after the reset.

5. New Series of Achievements
1) The new "Warrior of All Arts" achievement series: 
Participate in matches under Special Rules in Tournament Match and complete specific requirements to unlock these achievements. Acquire the "Warrior of All Arts" title by completing the whole series.
2) The new "Grand Gallery" achievement series: 
Collect a certain number of Illustrations to unlock achievements. Acquire the "Grand Gallery" title by completing the whole series.

*Due to system limitations, certain achievements cannot retroactively track data from before the implementation of the achievement system.
*Please refer to the in-game performance for achievement details.

6. New Friend Note Feature
You can now add a note to your friends. Click the "Add Note" button on the friend's profile page to add a note name, which will be displayed in matches, game logs, rank, and other related interfaces.

*Please protect personal information when livestreaming or sharing game interface publicly; avoid using real names or sensitive details as note names.
*Note will be hidden when "Streamer Mode" is enabled in settings.
*Please refer to the actual in-game implementation for detailed rules.

7. Others
Reduced the completion requirements for certain daily missions.

notes.title: Mahjong Soul Steam Version FAQs
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Mahjong Soul on Steam!

Version Differences & Payment Methods
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073129/72b1b33068c2469c061359b5416b06ccea1153ed.png

Common Questions
1. Q: Can I play with my Mahjong Soul account from other platforms (iOS/Android/Browser/Windows Client) on the Steam version of Mahjong Soul?
A: Yes, you can play with your game account from other platforms on the Steam version of Mahjong Soul. Account data (such as rank, characters, skins, etc.) and progress will be synchronized.

 2. Q: What login methods are supported for the Steam version of Mahjong Soul?
A: The Steam version of Mahjong Soul currently supports logging in with Yostar (email), Facebook, Apple ID and Google accounts. 
If you use a Yostar (email), Facebook, Apple ID or Google account for login, please click on the corresponding icon on the login screen to log in.
* if you use X (Twitter) for login, you can open the Mahjong Soul game on your device and go to Settings > Others > Account Settings to link an email. Then, use that email to log into Mahjong Soul on Steam.

3. Does the Steam version of Mahjong Soul support macOS?
A: Mahjong Soul does not currently support Mac OS. Mac users can play Mahjong Soul via the Browser version.

4. Q: Can I use Jade and Outfit Vouchers obtained on other platforms (iOS/Android/Browser/Windows Client) in the Steam version of Mahjong Soul?
A: The Steam version shares paid Jade/Outfit Vouchers with the Browser and Windows Client version, but not with Android or iOS. However, free Jade/Outfit Vouchers are shared across all platforms.

5. Q: Can players on the Steam version of Mahjong Soul play together with players from other platforms (iOS/Android/Browser/Windows Client)?
A: Yes, they can all play together.

6. Q: I'm a beginner at Riichi Mahjong / I want to introduce Mahjong Soul to my friends. Where can I learn how to play Riichi Mahjong? 
A: You can check in-game guide by clicking the "?" icon on the main screen. Or check the official guide "Mahjong Soul Classroom" on the Guides page at Steam

For more questions, please contact us: mjs.cs@yo-star.com
